en: Sutayda bint al-Husayn ibn Isma'il al-Mahamili
tr: Süteyde bt. el-Hüseyin b. İsmâîl el-Mehâmilî
ar: ستيتة بنت الحسين بن إسماعيل المحاملي

description.tr: Ortaçağ İslam tarihinde belgelenen az sayıdaki kadın matematikçiden biri — cebir, aritmetik ve matematiksel olarak karmaşık İslam miras hukuku (ferâiz) konusunda uzman || Babası el-Mehâmilî önde gelen bir Bağdat kadısıydı. Hem matematik hem hukuk bilimlerinde üstünlük gösterdi. || [Tarih notu] Hatîb el-Bağdâdî ve İbnü'l-Cevzî tarafından anılır.
description.en: One of the few documented female mathematicians in medieval Islamic history — mastered algebra, arithmetic, and the mathematically complex Islamic inheritance law (faraidh) || Her father al-Mahamili was a prominent Baghdadi judge. She excelled in both mathematical and legal sciences, demonstrating that women could achieve mastery in the most technical disciplines. || [Historiographical note] Mentioned by al-Khatib al-Baghdadi and Ibn al-Jawzi. Her expertise in faraidh (inheritance math) shows how Islamic law created demand for female mathematical literacy.
description.ar: من أوائل عالمات الرياضيات الموثقات في التاريخ الإسلامي الوسيط || كان أبوها المحاملي قاضياً بارزاً في بغداد
